method: Sequential isolated processes, preserved old native module versus rebuilt compact-sample module. Same nine-stone start, 49 inventory stones, seed 0, 1024 iterations, evaluation256, placement32/native128, CPU result32 and four workers. Earlier CPU placement finalization remains reverted. Python placement detects bulk sample capability and uses the legacy path on the old module. No change to GPU kernels, physics, sample stride, final poses, containment grid or search configuration. Single-seed timing comparison; native timings are host wrapper intervals, not GPU kernel timestamps.

validation.additional_check: Optional untimed compact-history copying verified after benchmark; only the None-times copy guard changed afterward, which the timed benchmark histories do not use.
